newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Wolters acquires French medical publisher.
newsitem.headline: Wolters acquires French medical publisher.

text.p: Wolters Kluwer NV said on Thursday it had acquired French medical publisher Arnette Blackwell S.A. from Blackwell Sciences Ltd.
The Dutch publisher said Arnette Blackwell had annual sales of some 35 million French francs or 11.5 million Dutch guilders.
Arnette Blackwell, which will be renamed Arnette, will become part of the business unit Initiatives Sante of Wolters Kluwer France, the company said.
The acquisition was in line with the policy of strengthening its worldwide medical publishing activities, it added. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
